entry.label: Purpose
entry.description: Purpose may be declared, negotiated, inferred from behaviour or attributed by an observer. These forms can conflict. Systems practice needs the conflict visible rather than forcing one slogan to do all the work.
entry.canonical_definition: A context-dependent orientation or attribution that makes some outcomes, distinctions and actions relevant and supplies criteria for judging performance or viability.

profile.title: Purpose
profile.canonical_definition: A context-dependent orientation or attribution that makes some outcomes, distinctions and actions relevant and supplies criteria for judging performance or viability.
profile.summary: Purpose may be declared, negotiated, inferred from behaviour or attributed by an observer. These forms can conflict. Systems practice needs the conflict visible rather than forcing one slogan to do all the work.
profile.why_it_matters: Purpose shapes boundaries, measures and acceptable trade-offs. A system can perform efficiently against an espoused purpose while repeatedly producing something else.
key_distinctions: purpose of an actor vs attributed purpose of a system
plural purposes vs one mission statement
practice_connections: avoid measuring proxies as if they were purposes
common_misreadings: the stated mission describes what the system does
purpose is merely a motivational slogan
profile.editorial_note: Readable orientation and evidence-backed first pass. Named editorial review is still required before canonical acceptance.
